slides.title: Answers Anchored Only in Your Own Sources
bullets: Built by Google on its Gemini models
Works with a defined set of documents the MSL uploads
Answers come only from those sources, not general model knowledge
Citations point to the exact passage behind each answer

slides.title: Upload Sources, Get Grounded Responses
bullets: User loads documents as the notebook's sources
Every answer after that draws exclusively from that content
Especially reliable when sources must stay central to the response
Ideal when every claim needs to trace to an exact passage

slides.title: Preparing for a Key KOL Interaction
bullets: Load the key publication, related study protocol, and prior notes on that KOL
Prepare answers to likely questions with exact passage traceability
After a congress, load team notes to find patterns or contradictions

slides.title: Summaries in Multiple Formats
bullets: Generates output in different formats from the same sources
Ranges from structured outlines to conversational formats
Useful for absorbing dense content during travel or downtime

slides.title: Grounding Reduces, Not Eliminates, Error
bullets: Anchoring only to provided sources cuts the risk of ungrounded content
Lower risk than general purpose tools, but not zero risk
MSL still confirms the synthesis accurately reflects the original nuance

takeaway.title: NotebookLM trades general flexibility for tightly sourced, traceable answers
bullets: Best for meeting prep and congress note synthesis from your own documents
Every answer is traceable to an exact passage, reducing fabrication risk
Human confirmation of nuance and accuracy is still required
